title: TTPO: Test-Time Policy Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2608.27448v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent prominent post-training methods, such as Reinforcement Learning (RL) and On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD), have driven rapid progress in mathematical reasoning for large language models, yet their reliance on ground-truth labels precludes test-time training (TTT). Replacing ground truth with majority-vote pseudo-labels is a natural alternative, yet it is fragile: an incorrect vote corrupts the teacher and misleads every token. We observe that this failure mode is asymmetric: rollouts that disagree with the pseudo-label are typically wrong regardless of whether the vote itself is correct. Building on this observation, we propose Test-Time Policy Optimization (TTPO), an asymmetric objective that distills agreeing rollouts via OPSD and penalizes disagreeing rollouts with Grouped RL. Token-level selection further refines both branches: distillation down-weights already-converged positions, while RL penalizes only confident errors. B

translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.27448v1 公告类型：新 摘要：近年来，诸如强化学习（RL）和同策略自蒸馏（OPSD）等突出的后训练方法，推动了大型语言模型在数学推理方面的快速进展，然而它们对真实标签的依赖阻碍了测试时训练（TTT）。用多数投票伪标签替代真实标签是一种自然的替代方案，但它很脆弱：一个错误的投票会污染教师模型并误导每个令牌。我们观察到这种失败模式是不对称的：与伪标签不一致的生成结果通常无论投票本身是否正确都是错误的。基于这一观察，我们提出了测试时策略优化（TTPO），一种不对称的目标函数，通过OPSD蒸馏一致的生成结果，并用分组RL惩罚不一致的生成结果。令牌级选择进一步细化两个分支：蒸馏降低已收敛位置的权重，而RL仅惩罚置信度高的错误。B
tldr: 本文提出TTPO，一种不对称的测试时策略优化方法，利用多数投票伪标签，通过蒸馏一致生成和分组RL惩罚不一致生成，实现无需真实标签的测试时训练。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes TTPO, an asymmetric test-time policy optimization method that leverages majority-vote pseudo-labels, distilling agreeing rollouts and penalizing disagreeing ones with grouped RL, enabling test-time training without ground-truth labels.
